narr: Isolated thunderstorms moved west across Pima County during the late afternoon and evening hours. A few storms produced damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: One to two inches of rain fell in less than 1 hour northeast of the Tucson International Airport causing flash flooding of area roads. One swift water rescue was conducted for a vehicle stalled in a wash.
One to two inches of rain in less than 1 hour from south of Ajo to east of Why. This caused flash flooding of area washes and the closure of Highway 86 east of Why and Highway 85 between Ajo and Why.
More than 1 of rain fell in less than 1 hour along South Wilmot Rd causing flash flooding and the closure of the roadway north of Sahuarita Rd.
lsr: FIRE DEPARTMENT RESCUED A VEHICLE IN THE WASH.
WILMOT RD IS CLOSED FROM TUCSON FIRE STATION 6 TO SAHUARITA RD DUE TO FLOODING.
